text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. Machine learning is a type of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses artificial neural networks to solve complex problems such as image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. It helps us when we use voice assistants, receive movie recommendations, unlock our phones with our faces, or get directions in a navigation app. AI is changing the way we live and work.
